def: Finding a good answer by generating candidates, testing them and using the results to choose the next candidates, instead of computing the answer directly.
Search toward a fixed objective, usually stopping when the score stops improving.
Search that keeps producing new and increasingly interesting results instead of converging on a single answer.
The stored record of every candidate tried so far and its score, from which parents are chosen.
The part of a search loop that makes a changed copy of a candidate, such as a random mutation or a language model's edit.
The part of a search loop that scores a candidate; flaws in it are what a search loop will exploit.
A deterministic function used in place of a language model so that examples run offline and give the same output every time.
